entry_authority.scientific_revision: New materially reduced fixed-eight-root science design after a zero-science resource NONPASS;not a correction,continuation or rerun of F8R1/F8R1C1.

claim_scope.question: For exactly eight frozen learner-reached public roots and frozen source-actor holes,does a bounded exact-V5.5 MCCFR+ root policy improve conditional paired value over canonical H11 under one common H11-P256-then-passive continuation?
not_authorized: checkpoint creation or official policy change
claim_scope.no_quick5k_reason: F8R2 changes no deployable checkpoint or official greedy-direct policy.

falsifiable_hypothesis.mechanism: A full-joint blocker-aware posterior and source-hole-oversampled depth-two MCCFR+ update can improve the frozen source actor's root distribution on eight fixed learner-reached decisions despite a bounded passive tail.
falsifiable_hypothesis.primary_estimand: theta=(1/8)*sum_r mean_s(d_rs),where d_rs is ensemble-root minus canonical-H11-root payoff on paired sealed E1 tape s conditional on root r and its source-actor hole.
falsifiable_hypothesis.primary_gate: One-sided fixed-root Welch-Satterthwaite 95% LCB(theta)>=+0.20 big blinds per reached root.
falsifiable_hypothesis.interpretation: The threshold is an engineering mechanism gate for exactly eight roots and has no bb/100 conversion.

counter_rng.bounded_integer: For n,limit=2^64-(2^64 mod n);reject uint64>=limit with incremented counter;return uint64 mod n.
counter_rng.deck: Fisher-Yates i=51 down to1 using CENSUS_DECK,hand_index,i and unbiased bounded_integer(i+1).

probability_and_lane_contract.probability: One LEGAL_LOGITS_CPU_F64_CDF_V1 routine:exact float32 logits copied to CPU;legal values cast float64,subtract legal max,exp,divide by float64 sum;illegal mass0;CDF in slot order with final legal value forced1;sample first CDF strictly greater than uniform.
probability_and_lane_contract.canonical: Canonical root/belief H11 uses fixed contiguous batch256 chunks,padded only by duplicate final real row with padding discarded.
probability_and_lane_contract.leaf: H11-P256 uses permanent512 lanes,two batch256 chunks,no compaction,profile-independent lanes and a73-step Latin translation.
probability_and_lane_contract.balance: Across2,048 solver iterations every logical lane occupies every physical position exactly4 times.
probability_and_lane_contract.pairing: Baseline,replicas and ensemble use separate passes but the same tape has the same lane,deal,chance and keyed continuation uniforms.

root_census_and_belief.selection: Preassign one cell per hand;within hand retain smallest eligible CENSUS_SELECT digest;between hands retain smallest candidate in each cell;never replace a missing or invalid root.
eligibility: at least two legal nonnull V5.5 slots
no seventh same-street action has occurred
selection excludes hidden cards,outcome,reward,probability and solver output
eight selected roots use distinct source hands
root_census_and_belief.joint_target: mu_r(h0,h1) proportional to uniform ordered disjoint-hole prior times chronological canonical-H11 observed-action likelihoods;normalize by CPU-f64 logsumexp;never multiply marginals.
root_census_and_belief.source_hole: Freeze source actor hole only after public selection;it must have positive marginal and never affects public selection or alternative-hole likelihoods.

game_tree_and_passive_tail.solver_actions: Exact executable nonnull V5.5 slots on a fresh exact-cent public engine.
game_tree_and_passive_tail.depth_count: Player decisions beginning at root;chance does not consume depth.
game_tree_and_passive_tail.cap_count: Count post-root H11-P256 player actions only;the candidate/baseline root action is not counted.
game_tree_and_passive_tail.passive_entry: If still nonterminal immediately after eight post-root H11-P256 actions,or before an otherwise-required seventh same-street action,enter the passive tail once and record the reason.
game_tree_and_passive_tail.passive_action: At every decision call min(to_call,stack) when to_call>0;otherwise check. Never fold,bet or raise. A short all-in call is legal and may leave unmatched excess to the exact-cent engine.
game_tree_and_passive_tail.passive_progress: After any call that closes action,deal the exact number of future board cards without replacement using the tape's frozen keyed chance stream;then check through remaining streets. If an outstanding bet remains,resolve the registered call before street advance. Continue until exact fold/all-in runout/river showdown terminal.
game_tree_and_passive_tail.passive_randomness: No policy or network calls occur in passive mode;future board randomness stays profile-paired.
forbidden: unresolved outstanding bet at street advance

solver.snapshots: single endpoint T=2048 only;no selection,extension,restart or top-up

proposal.source_event: A={root actor own hole equals frozen source hole}
proposal.sampling: Sample from full q and apply mu/q exactly once.

solver.iteration: For each root and replica freeze sigma_t;run independent traverser0 and traverser1 samples from q;sample chance/nontraverser laws;enumerate traverser legal slots;collect both delta tables;apply simultaneously.
solver.regret: DeltaR=w*(y_a-sum sigma*y);apply both traversals then R=max(0,R+DeltaR);normalize positive legal regrets or use legal-uniform at zero.
solver.source_root_average: Before each update S(a)+=t*sigma_t(I_star,a),D=2048*2049/2;one stream per replica;candidate is equal average of the two endpoints.

E0.conditional_deal: Fix source actor hole;sample opponent hole from mu(h_opp|source hole);sample future cards without replacement.
E0.continuation: All profiles use identical H11-P256-cap8 then passive-tail law.
E0.pairing: Same opponent hole,chance,root uniform,permanent lane and keyed post-root uniforms across profiles.
E0.inference: Use the same fixed-root analytic function registered for E1;no bootstrap.
E0.failure: Terminal F8R2 scientific NONPASS;E1 remains sealed.

E1.sealed_before_E0: Seed-manifest bytes and SHA exist before E0 and are unavailable to the solver/E0 process.
E1.open_condition: Fresh process requires immutable candidate manifest binding replicas,ensemble,E0 raw hashes and unopened E1 manifest SHA.
E1.conditional_deal_pairing_and_continuatio: Exactly the E0 estimand with disjoint E1 keys and the same H11-P256-cap8 passive-tail law.
E1.raw_evidence: Retain one create-new JSONL row per root,tape and profile with deal/action/chance/lane/fallback/terminal trace and payoff plus a paired-difference row binding both profile rows.
E1.primary_gate: theta one-sided95% LCB>=0.20 big blinds per reached root.
E1.failure: Terminal F8R2 scientific NONPASS;never return to E0,change candidate,top up or reuse E1.

analytic_confidence.experimental_units: Independent paired tapes conditional on each fixed root/source hole.
analytic_confidence.differences: d_rs=candidate payoff minus baseline payoff in big blinds.
analytic_confidence.root_statistics: For each root r,n_r fixed;mean_r=sum_s d_rs/n_r;s_r_squared=sum_s(d_rs-mean_r)^2/(n_r-1) using float64.
analytic_confidence.degenerate_rule: If V=0,LCB=theta and df=positive infinity only if every d_rs is finite and all integrity/pairing gates pass;otherwise NONPASS.
analytic_confidence.fixed_roots: Roots are never resampled;no root-population variance or generalization is claimed.
analytic_confidence.multiplicity: One preregistered E1 primary quantity;no multiplicity adjustment.
